summary: The diff does not implement the requested Email+Password or OTP backend APIs, and the frontend Login page still contains placeholder/TODO logic that throws "not yet implemented" errors. Admin redirect via useEffect exists for authenticated sessions, but the new login methods are not wired end-to-end, so routing requirements for those flows are not met. A separate unrequested change tightens admin key authentication behavior.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement backend Email+Password authentication APIs (login endpoint, session association of caller Principal to email identity, bootstrap admin email->Admin role assignment, seeded admin credentials jogoshree@gmail.com / Admin@123).
missing_requirements.reason: No Email+Password login API is visible in backend/main.mo, and the frontend explicitly comments that the backend API is not implemented.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement backend OTP request + verify APIs with expiry, and associate caller Principal with identifier on success; must work without external delivery providers.
missing_requirements.reason: No OTP request/verify API is visible in backend/main.mo, and the frontend OTP handlers are still TODO placeholders that throw "OTP authentication backend API is not yet implemented".

missing_requirements.requirement: Update frontend Login page to remove placeholder/toast-only behavior for Email+Password and OTP tabs and wire both to backend APIs with clear English success/failure messages and correct redirects.
missing_requirements.reason: Email+Password submit handler simulates a call then throws an error stating backend API is not implemented and toasts an error; OTP request handler similarly contains TODO/simulated call and throws not-implemented error text.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure Admin routing behavior after successful login across Internet Identity, Email+Password, and OTP (/admin for Admin, / for non-admin).
missing_requirements.reason: While there is a redirect useEffect for authenticated sessions, Email+Password and OTP logins are not implemented/wired, so their post-login role-based redirects cannot be satisfied end-to-end.

missing_requirements.requirement: Run a focused full build pass (frontend + backend) and fix compile/runtime blockers; ensure /login works end-to-end for Email+Password and OTP without placeholder toasts/unimplemented code paths.
missing_requirements.reason: The /login page still hits explicit unimplemented code paths (throws errors and toasts about backend APIs not implemented) for Email+Password and OTP, which violates the end-to-end exercise requirement.

hallucinated_features.description: Changed authenticateAdmin to require the caller already be an Admin to authenticate with public keys (security fix / prevents privilege escalation).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest focuses on implementing Email+Password and OTP login plus admin redirect behavior; it does not request changes to the public-key admin authentication pathway.
